text:
Alex (AE): FYI, handing off the Vega Health deal to CS. signed MSA today, 12-month, committed Dedicated capacity (4 gpus) + Hosted fallback. big win but a couple red flags on SSO and data retention. cc @Priya (CSM) and @Mei (SRE)
Priya (CSM): thanks Alex. can you drop the contract link and any notes on pilot success metrics?
Alex (AE): Contract: https://redwood.example/contract/VEGA-2026. Pilot metrics: 95th p50 latency target met on small test, throughput goal ~120 rps, token costs ran ~0.9x estimate. they used our reranking flow and liked response consistency.
Alex (AE): Risks: 1) customer insists on IdP SCIM + inbound SAML attribute mapping that we haven't validated in their Okta org. 2) legal flagged 90-day audit log retention vs their 2-year req. 3) timeline pressure: they want PROD in 6 weeks.
Priya (CSM): got it. I'll triage SSO with infra and support. Mei — can you validate SCIM + SAML mapping for a Dedicated tenant?
Mei (SRE): @Priya I can run a compatibility check. need Okta admin access or a test org config. also need to confirm whether log retention can be exported to their S3 (workaround for 2yr).
Jordan (Support): tagging support runbook items: will create a support ticket for SSO enablement and one for retention export. assign to eng if we need infra changes.
Alex (AE): timeline: onboarding kickoff week of May 9. customer expectations: single sign-on, private VPC peering optional, and a canary rollout schedule.
Priya (CSM): owners and action items: - Priya: kickoff, weekly check-ins, acceptance criteria doc with customer - Mei: SSO compatibility report + retention options by 3 business days - Jordan: open support tickets and initial triage by EOD tomorrow - Alex: send customer onboarding contacts and engineers
Mei (SRE): plan: 1) request Okta metadata 2) validate attribute mapping 3) test SCIM provisioning in staging Dedicated tenant 4) report back with any infra gaps. aiming for results in 48-72h.
Jordan (Support): created ticket #SUP-8782 - "Vega Health: SSO + SCIM validation" and #SUP-8783 - "Audit log export/retention options". pinged eng-oncall for potential infra work.
Priya (CSM): I'll draft acceptance criteria template and share in this thread. also capturing renewal risk: their legal asked for audit guarantees, mark Renewal_Risk=medium until resolved.
Alex (AE): noted. customer success metric: go-live = ingest 100k tokens/day with <200ms p95 for generation routes. keep me looped if we hit infra blockers; I'll coordinate account execs.
Mei (SRE): quick note — if SCIM mapping needs a schema change, may require a minor config rollout; flagging potential 1-week delay.
Jordan (Support): @Mei if you need deeper eng support I can escalate to eng-platform; include repro steps in ticket.
Priya (CSM): thanks team. next steps: Mei to post SCIM findings here by 1791234800, Jordan to update tickets, Alex to provide customer contacts. Mei/Jordan/Priya — let's meet Wednesday 10am PT for sync. :calendar: 
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: "Vega onboarding sync" Wed 10:00 PT (invite sent to Priya, Mei, Jordan, Alex) :bell:
Priya (CSM): closing note — logging feedback capture item: customer requested better cost transparency per routing policy. I'll add to our product feedback board and loop in product once SSO/retention are handled.
